Documentation / Overview

France E-Invoicing API

ClearTax is a certified Plateforme Agréée (PA) for the French e-invoicing mandate. This documentation covers the Send API for submitting invoices from your ERP to ClearTax.

Submission Flow

APIs and Structure

MethodEndpointDescriptionStatus
POST/einvoice/v1/documents/sendSubmit one or more invoice documents for validation and routing to the buyer via Peppol.Available
GET/einvoice/v1/documents/{document_id}/statusGet document current lifecycle status and check whether this document was successfully reported to PPF.Coming soon
GET/einvoice/v1/documents/queryRetrieve a list of e-invoice documents filtered by date range, type, and pagination.Coming soon
GET/einvoice/v1/documentsRetrieve a single e-invoice document by its document number.Coming soon
POST/einvoice/v1/documents/actionUpdate the lifecycle status of an invoice (e.g. approve, refuse, dispute).Coming soon
GET/einvoice/v1/documents/printGet the PDF version of an e-invoice based on the invoice identifiers.Coming soon
POST/einvoice/v1/documents/emailSend an e-invoice to the buyer via email.Coming soon
POSTCustomer-configured URLWebhook callback. ClearTax pushes lifecycle event notifications (e.g. buyer approved, refused, disputed, payment received) to your registered endpoint in real-time.Coming soon

API REFERENCE

Send e-Invoice

POST/einvoice/v1/documents/send

Submit one or more invoice documents for validation and routing. ClearTax validates, transforms to UBL, files with PPF, and delivers via Peppol. Supports up to 10 documents per request.

Request Headers

HeaderTypeRequiredValue / Description
x-cleartax-auth-tokenStringMandatoryYour workspace auth token
x-clear-country-codeEnumMandatoryFR
x-einvoice-typeEnumMandatorySALES for outbound invoices
x-clear-sirenStringMandatorySeller's 9-digit SIREN. e.g. 732829320
x-clear-siretStringMandatorySeller's 14-digit SIRET
Content-TypeStringMandatoryapplication/json

Request Body

The request body wraps one or more documents. The invoice data is Base64-encoded JSON inside documentData.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
documentsArrayMandatoryList of invoice documents. Min: 1, Max: 10.
documents[].documentDataStringMandatoryBase64-encoded JSON of the invoice object.
JSON
{
  "documents": [
    {
      "documentData": "eyJpZCI6IklOVi0wMDEiLC4uLn0="
    }
  ]
}

Request Schema

The invoice JSON payload contains 453 fields organised into 16 groups. Fields marked 1..1 or 1..n are mandatory; 0..1 or 0..n are optional.

Sample Response

HTTP Status Codes

HTTP Status CodeDescription
200For successfully submitted document or with validation errors
400For any kind of Invalid Payload issues
401If the user is not authenticated for the operation
403If the user is not authorized for the operation
406Indicates failure in parsing of payload, e.g. due to invalid value for a field
429Rate limit exceeded
5xxInternal exception

Response Schema

ParameterData TypeDescription
SuccessBooleanAlways present. Indicates the request was successful or not.
DocumentResponsesArrayList of document response objects corresponding to documents in request.

Document Response Object

ParameterData TypeDescription
DocumentIdStringUnique document ID, generated by database. To be used in Status Check API.
UniqueIdStringUnique ID generated by ClearTax to distinctly identify the document.
SuccessBooleanIndicates, if the request for this document was successfully processed or not.
ErrorDetailsArrayOptional. Error list from ClearTax.
WarningDetailsArrayOptional. Warning list from ClearTax.

Error Details Object

ParameterData TypeField ValidationsDescription
ErrorCodeStringCannot be nullA code to identify the error.
ErrorMessageStringCannot be nullHuman readable error message.
ErrorSourceStringPossible values: CLEARTAX, VALIDATION_ERRORSource of the error.
PathStringIf it is a validation error of a request data, it will point to the request data.

Warning Details Object

ParameterData TypeField ValidationsDescription
CodeStringCannot be nullA code to identify the warning.
MessageStringCannot be nullHuman readable warning message.

Validations

Field Requirements

Field-level validation rules applied by ClearTax during invoice processing. These are extracted from the compliance template. 122 fields have specific validation rules.

Invoice Level Details

BT CodeField NamePathCardinalityValidation Rules
BT-1Invoice Numberinvoice.id1..11. Mandatory - Yes – every invoice must have an Invoice Number 2. Unique per supplier - Must not repeat across invoices from the same seller for the same Year 3. Chronological order recommended - Should reflect issuance order (e.g., INV-2025-001 → INV-2025-002) 4. Should be Alphanumeric characters (A-Z, a-z, 0-9 5. No spaces or special characters Avoid /, \, #, or symbols; use- hyphen ("-") sign "+"underscore (_)slash (/) 6. Must match legal records - Number must align with seller’s internal accounting and VAT records 7. Referenced in credit notes - Required for linking via Credit or Debit Notes when the same is issued 8. An Invoice MUST have an Invoice number with length less than 50 characters
BT-2Invoice Issue Dateinvoice.issueDate1..1YYYY-MM-DD
BT-3Invoice Type Codeinvoice.invoiceTypeCode.value1..1An Invoice shall have an Invoice type code (BT-3). Total transaction types = 16 (France e-invoicing document codes) Simple invoices → 4 types - 380, 389, 393, 501 Down payment invoices → 2 types - 386, 500 Amended invoices → 4 types - 384, 471, 472, 473 Credit notes → 6 types - 261, 262, 381, 396, 502, 503
BT-5Document Currency Codeinvoice.documentCurrencyCode1..1An Invoice shall have an Invoice currency code (BT-5). All currencyID attributes must have the same value as the Invoice currency code, except for amounts expected to be in Tax accounting currency. Tax currency code MUST be coded using ISO code list 4217 alpha-3
BT-23Profile IDinvoice.profileID0..11.BR-FR-08: Billing Framework The authorized values for the Framework (Billing Method) are: B1: Submission of an invoice for goods S1: Submission of an invoice for services M1: Submission of a double invoice (delivery of goods and services that are not incidental to each other) B2: Submission of an invoice for goods already paid S2: Submission of an invoice for services already paid M2: Submission of a double invoice already paid B4: Submission of a final invoice (after down payment) for goods S4: Submission of a final invoice (after down payment) for services M4: Submission of a double final invoice (after down payment) S5: Submission of a service invoice by a subcontractor S6: Submission of a service invoice by a co-contractor B7: Submission of an invoice for goods that has been the subject of e-reporting (VAT already collected) S7: Submission of an invoice for services that has been the subject of e-reporting (VAT already collected) 2.BR-FR-CO-08: Final Invoice Billing Framework If the billing framework (BT-23) is: - B4: Final invoices (after down payment) for goods - S4: Final invoices (after down payment) for services - M4: Duplicate final invoices (after down payment) THEN the invoice type cannot be: - Down payment invoice (386) - Self-billed down payment invoice (500) - Down payment invoice credit note (503) 3.BR-FR-CO-09: Billing Frame Already Paid If the billing frame (BT-23) is: - B2: Submission of an invoice for goods already paid - S2: Submission of an invoice for services already paid - M2: Submission of a duplicate invoice already paid THEN - The amount already paid (BT-113) is equal to the total amount of the invoice including VAT (BT-112) - the net amount to pay (BT-115) is equal to 0 - the due date (BT-9) MUST indicate the date the invoice was paid
BT-24Customization IDinvoice.customizationID1..1[BR-01]-An Invoice shall have a Specification identifier (BT-24). e-invoicing e-reporting Invoice BR-FR-MAP-15: BT-24 MAPPING For flow 1, BT-24 must be equal to: urn.cpro.gouv.fr:1p0:einvoicingextract#Base for the START profile, without the lines urn.cpro.gouv.fr:1p0:einvoicingextract#Full for the full profile (TARGET)"
BT-25Linked Invoice Number for Credit/Debit Note /Correction Invoiceinvoice.billingReference[].additionalDocumentReference.id1..1Must be reported in case of Credit note 1. Mandatory - Yes – every invoice must have an Invoice Number 2. Unique per supplier - Must not repeat across invoices from the same seller for the same Year 3. Chronological order recommended - Should reflect issuance order (e.g., INV-2025-001 → INV-2025-002) 4. Should be Alphanumeric characters (A-Z, a-z, 0-9 5. No spaces or special characters Avoid /, \, #, or symbols; use- hyphen (""-"") sign ""+""underscore (_)slash (/) 6. Must match legal records - Number must align with seller’s internal accounting and VAT records 7. Referenced in credit notes - Required for linking via Credit or Debit Notes when the same is issued 8. An Invoice MUST have an Invoice number with length less than 50 characters "
BT-26Linked Invoice Date for Credit/ Debit Note /Correction Invoiceinvoice.billingReference[].additionalDocumentReference.issueDate0..1Must be reported in case of Credit note YYYY-MM-DD The year of a date MUST BE between 2000 and 2099 An Invoice shall have an Invoice issue date (BT-2).
EXT-FR-FE-02Type of previous invoiceinvoice.billingReference[].additionalDocumentReference.documentTypeCode0..1Document Type= 16 (France e-invoicing document codes) Simple invoices → 4 types - 380, 389, 393, 501 Down payment invoices → 2 types - 386, 500 Amended invoices → 4 types - 384, 471, 472, 473 Credit notes → 6 types - 261, 262, 381, 396, 502, 503

Invoice level details

BT CodeField NamePathCardinalityValidation Rules
BT-6Tax Currency Codeinvoice.taxCurrencyCode0..1[BR-53]-If the VAT accounting currency code (BT-6) is present, then the Invoice total VAT amount in accounting currency (BT-111) shall be provided. All currencyID attributes must have the same value as the Invoice currency code, except for amounts expected to be in Tax accounting currency. Tax currency code MUST be coded using ISO code list 4217 alpha-3

Document Reference

BT CodeField NamePathCardinalityValidation Rules
BT-7Tax point dateinvoice.taxPointDate0..1VAT due date (BT-7), which is not used like this in France, but as an event in BT-8, to indicate whether VAT is due on the invoice date or delivery date (VAT debit) or on the payment date (VAT on collection)/ BT-8 is mandatory only for service invoices for which the SELLER has opted for debits. Otherwise, it may or may not be present.
BT-8Tax point date codeinvoice.invoicePeriod.descriptionCode0..1VAT on debits, VAT is due when the corresponding amount is debited from the "customer" account. It is emphasized that the option to pay the tax based on debits cannot delay the tax due date. Value added tax point date (BT-7) and Value added tax point date code (BT-8) are mutually exclusive.
BT-12Contract Document Referenceinvoice.contractDocumentReferences[].id.value0..1Contract reference (BT-12): necessary in particular for recurring services managed without purchase order number (fluids, telephony) Must be reportd if the Document type is 262 in BT-3
BT-13Purchase Order Referenceinvoice.orderReference.id0..1A Purchase Order reference generated by the BUYER (BT-13): data often required for all purchasing processes that involve the generation of a Purchase Order, transmitted at the time of the order, and not after delivery or invoicing. As a reminder, pursuant to Article L. 441-9 of the French Commercial Code, the invoice must mention the purchase order number when it has been previously established by the buyer. If received before the invoice is made so it should be part of the Invoice as per French Commericla code
BT-18Invoiced object identifierinvoice.additionalDocumentReference[].id0..nMultiple references allowed (BT-18 / BT-128) The document and line-level invoice object identifier can now occur multiple times. This supports situations where: -One invoice must refer to several prior documents, or -One line is linked to multiple previous documents. This is needed for advanced CTC workflows (e.g., corrective flows, sub-contracting, grouped operations)
BT-21Invoice note subject codeinvoice.notes[].value (subject code as prefix)0..11. BR-FR-05 (Mandatory Notes) Every invoice must contain at least 3 specific notes: PMT → Fixed €40 late payment penalty (text in BT-22) PMD → Penalty for late payment (custom, per company rules) AAB → Discount or no-discount information These are compulsory and must always appear. 2. BR-FR-06 (Uniqueness Rule) The following subject codes must appear only once per invoice: PMT, PMD, AAB and TXD No duplicates allowed for these notes. 3. BR-FR-MAP-04 (Note Mapping for Transmission) Only PMT, PMD, AAB, and TXD need to be transmitted in Flow 1 or Flow 10.1 Mapping:TT-26 = BT-21 (note subject code) TT-27 = BT-22 (note text) Any other notes are optional in Flow 10/10.1. Keeps flows lean by focusing on required codes. 4. BR-FR-MAP-06 (Special TXD Case) If a note has: BT-21 = TXD BT-22 = "SINGLE_TAXI_MEMBER" Then in Flow 1 it must be transcoded to:"Member of a single taxable person" In summary (one-liners) BR-FR-05: Invoices must always have PMT, PMD, AAB notes. BR-FR-06: PMT, PMD, AAB, TXD must appear only once. BR-FR-MAP-04: Only PMT, PMD, AAB, TXD are required in Flows 1 & 10.1.
BT-22Invoice noteinvoice.notes[].value1..11. BR-FR-05 (Mandatory Notes) Every invoice must contain at least 3 specific notes: PMT → Fixed €40 late payment penalty (text in BT-22) PMD → Penalty for late payment (custom, per company rules) AAB → Discount or no-discount information These are compulsory and must always appear. 2. BR-FR-06 (Uniqueness Rule) The following subject codes must appear only once per invoice: PMT, PMD, AAB and TXD No duplicates allowed for these notes. 3. BR-FR-MAP-04 (Note Mapping for Transmission) Only PMT, PMD, AAB, and TXD need to be transmitted in Flow 1 or Flow 10.1 Mapping:TT-26 = BT-21 (note subject code) TT-27 = BT-22 (note text) Any other notes are optional in Flow 10/10.1. Keeps flows lean by focusing on required codes. 4. BR-FR-MAP-06 (Special TXD Case) If a note has: BT-21 = TXD BT-22 = "SINGLE_TAXI_MEMBER" Then in Flow 1 it must be transcoded to:"Member of a single taxable person" In summary (one-liners) BR-FR-05: Invoices must always have PMT, PMD, AAB notes. BR-FR-06: PMT, PMD, AAB, TXD must appear only once. BR-FR-MAP-04: Only PMT, PMD, AAB, TXD are required in Flows 1 & 10.1.
BT-73Invoice Period Start Dateinvoice.invoicePeriod.startDate0..1For all subscription services or for end-of-year discounts for which it is necessary to specify a reference period. Used when the invoice covers a billing period (e.g., monthly subscription, rental, utility bills, telecom services). YYYY-MM-DD The year of a date MUST BE between 2000 and 2099 If Invoicing period (BG-14) is used, the Invoicing period start date (BT-73) or the Invoicing period end date (BT-74) shall be filled, or both. [BR-29]-If both Invoicing period start date (BT-73) and Invoicing period end date (BT-74) are given then the Invoicing period end date (BT-74) shall be later or equal to the Invoicing period start date (BT-73).
BT-74Invoice Period End Dateinvoice.invoicePeriod.endDate0..1For all subscription services or for end-of-year discounts for which it is necessary to specify a reference period. Used when the invoice covers a billing period (e.g., monthly subscription, rental, utility bills, telecom services). YYYY-MM-DD The year of a date MUST BE between 2000 and 2099 If Invoicing period (BG-14) is used, the Invoicing period start date (BT-73) or the Invoicing period end date (BT-74) shall be filled, or both. [BR-29]-If both Invoicing period start date (BT-73) and Invoicing period end date (BT-74) are given then the Invoicing period end date (BT-74) shall be later or equal to the Invoicing period start date (BT-73).
BT-122Supporting document referenceinvoice.additionalDocumentReference[].id1..1Within the supporting-documents group (IBG-24), this field is mandatory (1..1) for each document entry. It is an identifier of the supporting document. What to provide: A unique reference or identifier for each supporting document. Could be a code, number, registration, or other unique ID. Example: “DOC-2025-INV005-CERT1” Or “InspectionReport-IR-3456” If you attach a PDF of the delivery note, you might have “DN-12345” as the reference.
BT-123Supporting document descriptioninvoice.additionalDocumentReference[].documentDescription0..1This is optional (0..1). Provides a descriptive text for the supporting document. What to provide: A short human-readable description explaining what the document is. Example: “Third-party inspection certificate confirming delivered quantity and quality” “Timesheet approved by client for service project” “Delivery note issued by forwarder on 2025-10-15”
BT-124External document locationMISSING: AdditionalDocumentReferenceType has no attachment field0..1Optional (0..1). It is the URL (Uniform Resource Locator) where the external document is located. In other words: if the supporting document is stored externally (rather than embedded), this is the link. What to provide: A valid web address or repository link where the invoice recipient can access the supporting document. Example: “https://documents.mycompany.eu/supportingDocs/InspectionReport-IR-3456.pdf”
BT-125Attached documentMISSING: AdditionalDocumentReferenceType has no attachment field0..1This field allows you to embed a supporting document directly inside the invoice payload as a binary object (e.g., PDF, image, certificate, XML), instead of referencing it using a URL (IBT-124). This is used when the supplier wants to attach a document physically with the invoice data, ensuring it always travels together and does not rely on external links.

BT-9Payment due dateinvoice.dueDate0..1If the invoice type is: - Deposit invoice (386) - Self-billed deposit invoice (500) (*), the deposit payment date must be completed if the deposit payment date is determined/known and is different from the issue date. BT-117VAT Amountinvoice.taxTotal[].taxSubtotal[].taxAmount1..1[BR-CO-17]-VAT category tax amount (BT-117) = VAT category taxable amount (BT-116) x (VAT category rate (BT-119) / 100), rounded to two decimals. Amount: this is a “Decimal” type with a maximum of 2 digits after the decimal point, without a thousand separator, and with the decimal separator. Example 10000.34
BT-118Tax category codeinvoice.taxTotal[].taxSubtotal[].taxCategory.id1..1Validation 1 S = Standard VAT rate [BR-AE-08]-In a VAT breakdown (BG-23) where the VAT category code (BT-118) is "Reverse charge" the VAT category taxable amount (BT-116) shall equal the sum of Invoice line net amounts (BT-131) minus the sum of Document level allowance amounts (BT-92) plus the sum of Document level charge amounts (BT-99) where the VAT category codes (BT-151, BT-95, BT-102) are "Reverse charge". [BR-AE-09]-The VAT category tax amount (BT-117) in a VAT breakdown (BG-23) where the VAT category code (BT-118) is "Reverse charge" shall be 0 (zero). [BR-AE-10]-A VAT breakdown (BG-23) with VAT Category code (BT-118) "Reverse charge" shall have a VAT exemption reason code (BT-121), meaning "Reverse charge" or the VAT exemption reason text (BT-120) "Reverse charge" (or the equivalent standard text in another language). Validation 2 Out of scope invoice will only contains details of Out of scope items. It will not contain any other type of VAT type items or details

EXT-FR-FE-136Previous invoice IDinvoice.invoiceLine[].billingReference[].additionalDocumentReference.id0..1Specific to France (Factur-X / French CIUS). Purpose: To indicate the previous invoice in a chain of invoices (not necessarily correction). → Used for sequencing or re-issuance (e.g., a replacement invoice, progressive billing, or corrected invoice in continuity). It is an additional French business rule, not part of base EU PINT. Example: If Invoice INV-2023-100 replaces an earlier version INV-2023-099 (same transaction, updated), then: EXT-FR-FE-136 = INV-2023-099.
EXT-FR-FE-137Type of previous invoice at line levelinvoice.invoiceLine[].billingReference[].additionalDocumentReference.documentTypeCode0..1To be reported when the previous invoice type was a deposit invoice.
EXT-FR-FE-138Previous invoice dateinvoice.invoiceLine[].billingReference[].additionalDocumentReference.issueDate0..1"In the ""Start"" path: - Corrective invoice: Field BT-25 (reference to a previous invoice) is mandatory. If the invoice type is: - Credit note: Field BT-25 (Reference to a previous invoice or contract number) is mandatory. If there are a set of invoices, the ""reference to a previous invoice"" field can be repeated multiple times (cardinality 1.n). In the ""Target"" path: - Corrective invoice: Fields BT-25 (reference to a previous invoice [only]) and BT-26 (date of the previous invoice [only]) are mandatory. If the invoice type is: - Credit note: Fields BT-25 (Reference to a previous invoice or contract number) and BT-26 (date of the previous invoice or contract) are mandatory. If there are a set of invoices, the ""reference to a previous invoice"" field can be repeated multiple times (cardinality 1.n). It is also possible to transmit this information at the invoice line level in the target path and outside of PDF submission. For example, if the invoice type is: - Amended invoice: The EXT-FR-FE-136 (reference to a previous invoice only) and EXT-FR-FE-138 (date of the previous invoice only) fields are mandatory. If the invoice type is: - Credit note: The EXT-FR-FE-136 (Reference to a previous invoice or contract number) and EXT-FR-FE-138 (date of the previous invoice or contract) fields are mandatory."

Payment Means Codes

Used in invoice.paymentMeans.paymentMeansCode.value.

168 entries â click to expand
CodeDescription
Instrument not defined
Not defined legally enforceable agreement between two or more parties (expressing a contractual right or a right to the payment of money).
Automated clearing house credit
A credit transaction made through the automated clearing house system.
Automated clearing house debit
A debit transaction made through the automated clearing house system.
ACH demand debit reversal
A request to reverse an ACH debit transaction to a demand deposit account.
ACH demand credit reversal
A request to reverse a credit transaction to a demand deposit account.
ACH demand credit
A credit transaction made through the ACH system to a demand deposit account.
ACH demand debit
A debit transaction made through the ACH system to a demand deposit account.
Hold
Indicates that the bank should hold the payment for collection by the beneficiary or other instructions.
National or regional clearing
Indicates that the payment should be made using the national or regional clearing.
In cashEspèces
Payment by currency (including bills and coins) in circulation, including checking account deposits.
ACH savings credit reversal
A request to reverse an ACH credit transaction to a savings account.
ACH savings debit reversal
A request to reverse an ACH debit transaction to a savings account.
ACH savings credit
A credit transaction made through the ACH system to a savings account.
ACH savings debit
A debit transaction made through the ACH system to a savings account.
Bookentry credit
A credit entry between two accounts at the same bank branch. Synonym: house credit.
Bookentry debit
A debit entry between two accounts at the same bank branch. Synonym: house debit.
ACH demand cash concentration/disbursement (CCD) credit
A credit transaction made through the ACH system to a demand deposit account using the CCD payment format.
ACH demand cash concentration/disbursement (CCD) debit
A debit transaction made through the ACH system to a demand deposit account using the CCD payment format.
ACH demand corporate trade payment (CTP) credit
A credit transaction made through the ACH system to a demand deposit account using the CTP payment format.
ChequeChèque
Payment by a pre-printed form on which instructions are given to an account holder (a bank or building society) to pay a stated sum to a named recipient.
Banker's draft
Issue of a banker's draft in payment of the funds.
Certified banker's draft
Cheque drawn by a bank on itself or its agent. A person who owes money to another buys the draft from a bank for cash and hands it to the creditor who need have no fear that it might be dishonoured.
Bank cheque (issued by a banking or similar establishment)
Payment by a pre-printed form, which has been completed by a financial institution, on which instructions are given to an account holder (a bank or building society) to pay a stated sum to a named recipient.
Bill of exchange awaiting acceptance
Bill drawn by the creditor on the debtor but not yet accepted by the debtor.
Certified cheque
Payment by a pre-printed form stamped with the paying bank's certification on which instructions are given to an account holder (a bank or building society) to pay a stated sum to a named recipient .
Local cheque
Indicates that the cheque is given local to the recipient.
ACH demand corporate trade payment (CTP) debit
A debit transaction made through the ACH system to a demand deposit account using the CTP payment format.
ACH demand corporate trade exchange (CTX) credit
A credit transaction made through the ACH system to a demand deposit account using the CTX payment format.
ACH demand corporate trade exchange (CTX) debit
A debit transaction made through the ACH system to a demand account using the CTX payment format.
Credit transferVirement
Payment by credit movement of funds from one account to another.
Debit transfer
Payment by debit movement of funds from one account to another.
ACH demand cash concentration/disbursement plus (CCD+)
credit A credit transaction made through the ACH system to a demand deposit account using the CCD+ payment format.
ACH demand cash concentration/disbursement plus (CCD+)
debit A debit transaction made through the ACH system to a demand deposit account using the CCD+ payment format.
ACH prearranged payment and deposit (PPD)
A consumer credit transaction made through the ACH system to a demand deposit or savings account.
ACH savings cash concentration/disbursement (CCD) credit
A credit transaction made through the ACH system to a demand deposit or savings account.
ACH savings cash concentration/disbursement (CCD) debit
A debit transaction made through the ACH system to a savings account using the CCD payment format.
ACH savings corporate trade payment (CTP) credit
A credit transaction made through the ACH system to a savings account using the CTP payment format.
ACH savings corporate trade payment (CTP) debit
A debit transaction made through the ACH system to a savings account using the CTP payment format.
ACH savings corporate trade exchange (CTX) credit
A credit transaction made through the ACH system to a savings account using the CTX payment format.
ACH savings corporate trade exchange (CTX) debit
A debit transaction made through the ACH system to a savings account using the CTX payment format.
ACH savings cash concentration/disbursement plus (CCD+)
credit A credit transaction made through the ACH system to a savings account using the CCD+ payment format.
Payment to bank accountPaiement sur compte bancaire
Payment by an arrangement for settling debts that is operated by the Post Office.
ACH savings cash concentration/disbursement plus (CCD+)
debit A debit transaction made through the ACH system to a savings account using the CCD+ payment format.
Accepted bill of exchange
Bill drawn by the creditor on the debtor and accepted by the debtor.
Referenced home-banking credit transfer
A referenced credit transfer initiated through home- banking.
Interbank debit transfer
A debit transfer via interbank means.
Home-banking debit transfer
A debit transfer initiated through home-banking.
Bank cardPaiement par carte bancaire
Payment by means of a card issued by a bank or other financial institution.
Direct debitPaiement par prélèvement
The amount is to be, or has been, directly debited to the customer's bank account.
Payment by postgiro
A method for the transmission of funds through the postal system rather than through the banking system.
FR, norme 6 97-Telereglement CFONB (French Organisation for
Banking Standards) - Option A A French standard procedure that allows a debtor to pay an amount due to a creditor. The creditor will forward it to its bank, which will collect the money on the bank account of the debtor.
Urgent commercial payment
Payment order which requires guaranteed processing by the most appropriate means to ensure it occurs on the requested execution date, provided that it is issued to the ordered bank before the agreed cut-off time.
Urgent Treasury Payment
Payment order or transfer which must be executed, by the most appropriate means, as urgently as possible and before urgent commercial payments.
Credit card
Payment made by means of credit card.
Debit card
Payment made by means of debit card.
Bankgiro
Payment will be, or has been, made by bankgiro.
Standing agreementMoyens de paiement convenu
The payment means have been previously agreed between seller and buyer and thus are not stated again.
SEPA credit transferVirement SEPA
Credit transfer inside the Single Euro Payment Area (SEPA) system.
SEPA direct debitPrélèvement SEPA
Direct debit inside the Single Euro Payment Area (SEPA) system.
Promissory note
Payment by an unconditional promise in writing made by one person to another, signed by the maker, engaging to pay on demand or at a fixed or determinable future time a sum certain in money, to order or to bearer.
Promissory note signed by the debtor
Payment by an unconditional promise in writing made by the debtor to another person, signed by the debtor, engaging to pay on demand or at a fixed or determinable future time a sum certain in money, to order or to bearer.
Promissory note signed by the debtor and endorsed by a bank
Payment by an unconditional promise in writing made by the debtor to another person, signed by the debtor and endorsed by a bank, engaging to pay on demand or at a fixed or determinable future time a sum certain in money, to order or to bearer.
Promissory note signed by the debtor and endorsed by a
third party Payment by an unconditional promise in writing made by the debtor to another person, signed by the debtor and endorsed by a third party, engaging to pay on demand or at a fixed or determinable future time a sum certain in money, to order or to bearer.
Promissory note signed by a bank
Payment by an unconditional promise in writing made by the bank to another person, signed by the bank, engaging to pay on demand or at a fixed or determinable future time a sum certain in money, to order or to bearer.
Promissory note signed by a bank and endorsed by another
bank Payment by an unconditional promise in writing made by the bank to another person, signed by the bank and endorsed by another bank, engaging to pay on demand or at a fixed or determinable future time a sum certain in money, to order or to bearer.
Promissory note signed by a third party
Payment by an unconditional promise in writing made by a third party to another person, signed by the third party, engaging to pay on demand or at a fixed or determinable future time a sum certain in money, to order or to bearer.
Promissory note signed by a third party and endorsed by a
bank Payment by an unconditional promise in writing made by a third party to another person, signed by the third party and endorsed by a bank, engaging to pay on demand or at a fixed or determinable future time a sum certain in money, to order or to bearer.
Online payment service
Payment will be made or has been made by an online payment service.
Transfer Advice
Transfer of an amount of money in the books of the account servicer. An advice should be sent back to the account owner.
Bill drawn by the creditor on the debtor
Bill drawn by the creditor on the debtor.
Bill drawn by the creditor on a bank
Bill drawn by the creditor on a bank.
Bill drawn by the creditor, endorsed by another bank
Bill drawn by the creditor, endorsed by another bank.
Bill drawn by the creditor on a bank and endorsed by a
third party Bill drawn by the creditor on a bank and endorsed by a third party.
Bill drawn by the creditor on a third party
Bill drawn by the creditor on a third party.
Bill drawn by creditor on third party, accepted and
endorsed by bank Bill drawn by creditor on third party, accepted and endorsed by bank.
Not transferable banker's draft
Issue a bankers draft not endorsable.
Not transferable local cheque
Issue a cheque not endorsable in payment of the funds.
Reference giro
Ordering customer tells the bank to use the payment system 'Reference giro'. Used in the Finnish national banking system.
Urgent giro
Ordering customer tells the bank to use the bank service 'Urgent Giro' when transferring the payment. Used in Finnish national banking system.
Free format giro
Ordering customer tells the ordering bank to use the bank service 'Free Format Giro' when transferring the payment. Used in Finnish national banking system.
Requested method for payment was not used
If the requested method for payment was or could not be used, this code indicates that.
Clearing between partnersReport / Compensation
Amounts which two partners owe to each other to be compensated in order to avoid useless payments.
JP, Electronically Recorded Monetary Claims
An electronically recorded monetary claim is a claim that is separate from the underlying debt that gave rise to its accrual.Therefore, even if an electronically recorded monetary claim is accrued as a means of payment of the underlying debt, the underlying debt will not be extinguished as a matter of course.
Mutually definedMoyen de paiement convenu
A code assigned within a code list to be used on an interim basis and as defined among trading partners until a precise code can be assigned to the code list.

Order acknowledgement document identifier

Reference number assigned to a goods declaration.
Debit card number
A reference number identifying a debit card.
Offer number
(1332) Reference number assigned by issuing party to an offer.

Reference number allocated by the bank to a batch of different underlying interbank transactions.

Reference number allocated by the bank to one specific interbank transaction.
Delivery order number

Partial shipment identifier

Enquiry number

Docket number
A reference number identifying the docket.
Civil action number
A reference number identifying the civil action.

Standard Carrier Alpha Code (SCAC) number

Customs valuation decision number
Reference by an importing party to a previous decision made by a Customs administration regarding the valuation of goods.
End use authorization number
Reference issued by a Customs administration authorizing a preferential rate of duty if a product is used for a specified purpose, see: 1001 = 990.
Anti-dumping case number
Reference issued by a Customs administration pertaining to a past or current investigation of goods "dumped" at a price lower than the exporter's domestic market price.
Customs tariff number

Declarant's reference number
Unique reference number assigned to a document or a message by the declarant for identification purposes.
Repair estimate number
A number identifying a repair estimate.
Customs decision request number
Reference issued by Customs pertaining to a pending tariff classification decision requested by an importer or agent.
Sub-house bill of lading number
Reference assigned to a sub-house bill of lading.
Tax payment identifier

Quota number
Reference number allocated by a government authority to identify a quota.
Transit (onward carriage) guarantee (bond) number
Reference number to identify the guarantee or security provided for Customs transit operation (CCC).
Customs guarantee number
Reference assigned to a Customs guarantee.
Replacing part number
New part number which replaces the existing part number.
Seller's catalogue number
Identification number assigned to a seller's catalogue.
Originator's reference
A unique reference assigned by the originator.
Declarant's Customs identity number

Importer reference number
Reference number assigned by the importer to identify a particular shipment for his own purposes.
Export clearance instruction reference number
Reference number of the clearance instructions given by the consignor through different means.
Import clearance instruction reference number
Reference number of the import clearance instructions given by the consignor/consignee through different means.
Goods declaration document identifier, Customs
[1426] Reference number, assigned or accepted by Customs, to identify a goods declaration.
Article number
A number that identifies an article.
Intra-plant routing
To define routing within a plant.
Stock keeping unit number
A number that identifies the stock keeping unit.
Text Element Identifier deletion reference
The reference used within a given TEI (Text Element Identifier) which is to be deleted.

Vehicle licence number
